title: Experts disagree on runtime/hooks/capability-gate.mjs
context:
Chief architect: both are fail-closed rules and fit together; the security claim covers every error path, and the architect's Claude-Code-route-only rule is already accepted through EX-integration-architect-4, so nothing is lost by recommending the security claim

Target: runtime/hooks/capability-gate.mjs
- security-auditor: the PreToolUse ask is written only on the pre-mutation seam and only when result.ask is set; any error in the allow-once path falls back to exit 2 (blocked), never to allow
- application-architect: the new PreToolUse ask output must only be written when ADAPTER is undefined (the Claude Code route, like the existing additionalContext write); on any other adapter a result with ask must fall back to the block path (exit 2), because exit 0 with a Claude-only JSON shape would let the edit through with no dialog
